community.evidence: We remain dedicated to leading the world into a more prosperous and progressive future

result.analyst_notes: Mostly navigation and teasers with few stated values. Aspirational, society-level framing led by the CEO quote 'We remain dedicated' in first-person plural. Innovation is the headline theme; employees appear only through passion-project copy. Financials are shown as bare facts. Customers, environment, integrity and safety are absent. Commitments are stated absolutely, not hedged.
